# Track Studio 1.2.9-rc.202611212002

## 中文

本轮继续只处理打包，不改音频引擎、Electron 版本与推理架构。

- 按原生模块的导入闭包裁剪 FFmpeg DLL。CI 原先会把 BtbN shared 构建里的全部 DLL 复制进包，其中 `avfilter`、`avdevice`、`swscale` 没有任何被导入的引用，属于从未被加载的负载；现在只保留导入表里真正可达的那几个，名单从导入表推导，不写死版本号。
- macOS 产物纳入打包审计：读 `app.asar` 头表并与磁盘实际文件比对，按 Mach-O 头判定二进制归属，确认 universal 包同时具备 x86_64 与 arm64，且没有混入 Windows DLL 或其它平台预编译绑定。
- 审计新增磁盘二进制格式扫描：`extraResources` 与 `app.asar.unpacked` 里的文件不经过 asar 清单，以前的规则看不到它们；现在按文件头（PE / Mach-O / ELF）逐个判定，与目标平台不符即失败。

本次 CI 实测：

| 产物 | 1.2.9-rc.202611211817 | 本版 | 变化 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 安装器 | 328,330,598 字节（313.12 MiB） | 314,480,737 字节（299.91 MiB） | −13.21 MiB |
| macOS universal dmg | 466,268,417 字节 | 466,275,688 字节 | 基本持平（本轮不改 mac 内容） |

- Windows 裁剪实际保留 4 个 DLL：`avcodec-63`、`avformat-63`、`avutil-61`、`swresample-7`；删除 `avfilter-12`（36.4 MiB）、`avdevice-63`（4.72 MiB）、`swscale-10`（2.41 MiB），共 43.54 MiB，`resources` 由 669.97 MiB 降到 626.43 MiB。
- Windows 审计：asar 1833 条目、磁盘上 19 个二进制全部为 PE、0 项违规。
- macOS 审计（本轮首次在真实产物上运行）：asar 1946 条目、`resources` 529.84 MiB、整包 1453.46 MiB、磁盘上 14 个二进制全部为 Mach-O、0 项违规、无重复二进制。`rust_package` 同时含 `index.darwin-arm64.node`（arm64）与 `index.darwin-x64.node`（x86_64），universal 两种架构齐备。

## English

Packaging-only again: the audio engine, Electron version and inference architecture are untouched.

- FFmpeg DLLs are now pruned to the native module's import closure. CI previously copied every DLL from the BtbN shared build, including `avfilter`, `avdevice` and `swscale`, which nothing imports and which were therefore never loaded. Only the reachable set is kept, derived from the import table rather than a hard-coded name list.
- The macOS bundle is now audited as well: the `app.asar` header is compared against the files on disk, binaries are classified by Mach-O header, and the universal bundle must carry both x86_64 and arm64 with no Windows DLLs or foreign prebuilt bindings mixed in.
- Added a disk-level binary format scan. Files under `extraResources` and `app.asar.unpacked` never appear in the asar listing, so the previous rules could not see them; each binary is now classified by its file header (PE / Mach-O / ELF) and rejected when it does not match the target platform.

Measured on this CI build:

| Artifact | 1.2.9-rc.202611211817 | This build | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows installer | 328,330,598 B (313.12 MiB) | 314,480,737 B (299.91 MiB) | −13.21 MiB |
| macOS universal dmg | 466,268,417 B | 466,275,688 B | unchanged (mac content untouched this round) |

- The Windows prune kept exactly four DLLs — `avcodec-63`, `avformat-63`, `avutil-61`, `swresample-7` — and removed `avfilter-12` (36.4 MiB), `avdevice-63` (4.72 MiB) and `swscale-10` (2.41 MiB), 43.54 MiB in total. `resources` went from 669.97 MiB to 626.43 MiB.
- Windows audit: 1833 asar entries, all 19 on-disk binaries are PE, zero violations.
- macOS audit (first run against a real artifact): 1946 asar entries, `resources` 529.84 MiB, whole bundle 1453.46 MiB, all 14 on-disk binaries are Mach-O, zero violations, no duplicate binaries. `rust_package` carries both `index.darwin-arm64.node` and `index.darwin-x64.node`, so both universal slices are present.
